summary.name: Code Snippets AI
summary.one_liner: A team code snippets library with an AI chat interface that can use open-source and closed-source LLMs and be given context from your codebase.
use_cases: Chatting with an LLM about your own code snippets
Building new features or fixing bugs with codebase context
Adding comments or documentation to code
Sharing and organizing snippets within a development team
Running local open-source models through Ollama
summary.what_it_does: Code Snippets AI is a snippet library for developers that pairs with an AI chat interface. The desktop apps let you chat with multiple open-source and closed-source LLMs in the same conversation, as long as the chosen model's context window fits the chat. Codebase indexing and vectorization provide context-aware answers, with embeddings computed via OpenRouter, OpenAI or Ollama. The product also includes team features such as organization member management with roles, usage tracking for LLM calls, AI context generation for snippets, and snippet sharing. The page lists Mac and Windows support, custom API keys and Ollama for local models.
notable: Multiple open- and closed-source LLMs usable in one chat, including via OpenRouter and Ollama
Codebase indexing and vectorization for context-aware answers
Team organization member management and snippet sharing
Free tier with bring-your-own AI key and 5-snippet limit; paid Pro and Enterprise plans with 14-day trial
caveats: Requires an OpenRouter and/or OpenAI API key for the embeddings and cloud models (per FAQ)
Free plan saves only 5 snippets to the library
Pro ($7.5/user/month) and Enterprise ($12.5/month) plans are paid, with 14-day free trials
Local codebase indexing is listed under Pro, not the free plan
